sources.stated_purpose: General federation inquiries; worker rights complaints are directed to the Labor Commissioner or relevant union.
sources.limitations: Confirm the current mailbox, remit and eligibility before correspondence. Preserve designated intake routes. Publication alone does not establish permission to send bulk messages. Do not include confidential records in ordinary outreach email. Deliverability not tested.
